input_dataset: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2026, public respondent-level CSV
outcome_question: How much do you trust the output from AI tools or AI agents as part of your workflow?
exclusion: Not sure / I do not use AI tools and unanswered trust question
cv: 3-fold stratified CV on training portion only
feature_scope: Predeclared developer background and reported AI usage, excluding post-outcome trust/sentiment/verification answers
uncertainty: 400 test-set bootstrap replicates for macro-F1 intervals
limits: self-reported trust, not observed correctness or programming skill
unadjusted experience group comparisons may be confounded
model selection and importance are exploratory
survey skip-logic and missingness may influence prediction
